dotline-widgets — DotText renderer
==================================

Source: https://github.com/oceansde012/dotline-widgets
Commit: b53a12aaf09f3572582dbd2c4278ea65f6a83306
File adapted: app/src/main/java/io/github/oceansde012/dotline/DotText.kt
Upstream license: MIT
Copyright (c) 2026 oceansde012

Adapted file in this repository:
  lawnchair/src/app/nothingui/widgets/DotText.kt

Changes made for DotWel Launcher:
- renamed the package to app.nothingui.widgets;
- removed the upstream Nd palette dependency and made lit/matrix/accent/off colours explicit
  parameters, using our own NothingUi palette tokens;
- added the matrix colour to the bitmap cache key;
- changed bar() to take explicit accent and off colours;
- kept the self-drawn 7-row glyph set and dot rendering algorithm;
- did not copy the upstream app, providers, MediaTracker, Ticker, services, fonts or assets.

Nothing here is affiliated with or endorsed by Nothing Technology Limited. The upstream fonts are
not bundled by this project; DotWel Launcher uses its own OFL Doto fonts under licenses/fonts/.
